description: This file defines a React component 'AgentsPanel' that manages a list of agents, including fetching, adding, viewing details, and deleting agents. It also handles UI state such as modals for adding and confirming deletion, and displays agent data in a table with associated functionalities.

methods.name: fetchAgents
methods.description: Fetches the list of agents from the server and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleAddAgent
methods.description: Opens the modal for adding a new agent.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Refetches the agents list upon successful addition of a new agent.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Prepares to delete an agent by setting the agent info to be deleted.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms deletion of the selected agent, calls the delete API, and handles success or failure.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation, clearing the agent to be deleted.
